title: Learning to Forecast on Multiple Spatiotemporal Hierarchies
abstract: arXiv:2610.21414v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hierarchical forecasting exploits aggregation structures that expose multiple views of the same underlying spatiotemporal forecasting problem, while ensuring coherence among forecasts. Individual series provide fine-grained information, while progressively coarser aggregates reveal temporal and spatial patterns at different scales. In the associated deep learning architectures, the hierarchy determines which aggregate series are available and how they are processed together with individual series (e.g., through reconciliation or message-passing operators). Different hierarchies thus provide distinct learning signals and inductive biases for forecasting the same collection of time series. Nonetheless, existing architectures are typically trained on a single, often fixed, structure. translated_title: 在多个时空层级结构上学习预测
translated_abstract: 分层预测利用聚合结构，为同一个底层时空预测问题提供多个视角，同时确保预测之间的连贯性。单个序列提供细粒度的信息，而逐级粗化的聚合则在不同尺度上揭示时间和空间模式。在相关的深度学习架构中，层级结构决定了哪些聚合序列可用，以及它们如何与单个序列共同处理（例如，通过协调算子或消息传递算子）。因此，不同的层级结构为预测同一组时间序列提供了不同的学习信号和归纳偏置。然而，现有的架构通常只在单一的、且往往是固定的结构上进行训练。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个图深度学习框架，该框架利用不同层级结构之间的变化作为多任务正则化。我们表明，联合学习……
tldr: 提出了一种图深度学习框架，将多个时空层级结构之间的差异作为多任务正则化进行联合训练，从而提升时空预测的效果。
